difficulty_reason: The author analyzes approximate Kolmogorov complexity along a two-step direct-product hybrid. Failure of symmetry would distinguish a direct-product output from random strings, and deterministic reconstruction then yields a short conditional description. This transfers a worst-case inequality from average-case NP easiness.
